title: Normalization of a strict finite scalar tensor representative
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E→L and a scheme W. Let direct be a functor from flat-term K-flat complexes over the completed E-coefficient sheaf to complexes of actual L-coefficient systems, with natural identifications of all finite evaluations with the direct ordinary finite scalar tensor complexes, as in [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data]. Assume these identifications send the actual successor transitions to the specified quotient tensor maps. For each good representative P, Q(direct(P)) is normalized: for every m≥n and every derived B_n-module Z, composition with its actual m-to-n transition induces a bijection from Hom(ev_n Q(direct(P)),Z) to Hom(ev_m Q(direct(P)),Res_(m,n) Z). No assertion about arbitrary integral derived objects or a derived coefficient-extension functor is made.

source.place: Proof of stage3-pur-extension-strict-representatives, step 3 (normalization on a good representative); Stacks 03D7, 06YY, 07A6 and 0941.

proof.text: Apply ordinary quotient association to the underlying complex and its given evaluation isomorphisms. This supplies a chain isomorphism and identifies its ordinary adjoint with the actual transition, for every n ≤ m.

Change of rings preserves K-flatness for the flat-term K-flat input. Transport K-flatness across the supplied finite evaluation isomorphism. Thus the finite quotient universal counit computes derived extension on the evaluated complex.

Localize the ordinary unit equation. The normalized derived quotient unit and naturality of the exact-restriction localization comparison show that the derived adjoint of the actual transition is the composite of the finite K-flat computation and the localized ordinary associator, conjugated by exact-evaluation comparisons. Each factor is invertible.

For every target Z, compose precomposition by that isomorphism with the derived quotient adjunction Hom equivalence. Its function is exactly f ↦ transition ≫ Res(f), by naturality of the adjunction. The composite is bijective, proving the unchanged normalization predicate.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction separates ordinary balanced association from the K-flat localization and Hom-bijection argument; the unit route is unchanged.

theorem coefficientExtensionStrictTensor_normalized
    (direct : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory ⥤
      CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L W) ℤ)
    (directEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
      direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n)
    (htransition : IsCoefficientExtensionStrictTransition l E L ι W direct directEvaluation)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l L W (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (direct.obj P))
